newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Fed's McDonough sees U.S. inflation staying low.
newsitem.headline: Fed's McDonough sees U.S. inflation staying low.

text.p: New York Federal Reserve Bank President William McDonough said on Tuesday he expected the low inflation trend in the United States to continue.
"We continue to have CPI (consumer price index) below three percent and there is every reason to think that trend will continue," McDonough told a conference in Hong Kong.
U.S. retail inflation stood at an annual rate of 2.3 percent in the third quarter.
"There is every reason to believe that the very fine performance of the U.S. economy will continue into 1997," McDonough added.
